# StreamDek Mobile v2.2.3-pre3 Release Notes

This release brings major player & audio-video experience enhancements to StreamDek Mobile:

### 🎬 Player & Audio-Video Experience Features:
1. **Auto-Select Preferred Audio Language (Dual Audio Fix)**:
   - Intelligent detection of preferred audio languages (Hindi, English, Tamil, Telugu, Spanish, French, etc.) even when stream metadata is unlabelled (`"und"` or `null`).
   - Automatically inspects track titles with multi-lingual keyword recognition to switch to your preferred language immediately upon stream load.
   - Smart fallback to secondary audio language preference.

2. **Speech / Dialogue Enhancer (Clear Voice Mode)**:
   - Built-in vocal EQ boost (1kHz–3.5kHz) and low-frequency rumble dampener to make dialogue crisp and audible over loud action scenes, explosions, and background scores.
   - Supported natively across all 3 playback engines: MPV (real-time equalizer audio filter), ExoPlayer (Android LoudnessEnhancer audio effect), and VLC (equalizer band tuning).
   - Convenient toggle available in the player Audio settings panel.

3. **Smart Gestures & Pinch-to-Zoom with HUD Overlay**:
   - Smooth pinch-to-zoom gesture allowing magnification from 1.0x up to 3.0x to eliminate black bars or focus on details.
   - Quick-cycle aspect ratio button supporting Fit to Screen (`contain`), Crop to Fill (`cover`), and Full (`stretch`).
   - Real-time on-screen HUD toast overlay displaying current zoom percentage (`Zoom 125%`, `Fit to Screen (100%)`, `Crop to Fill`, `Stretch`).

4. **Listen in Background / Screen-Off Mode**:
   - New player toggle allowing continuous background audio playback when the screen is locked or the app is minimized.
   - Surface texture detachment without terminating the playback engine, ensuring smooth background listening and instant resumption when the screen wakes up.
